changeSet.author: navigator
changeSet.comment: v_campaign_health: per-campaign call metrics with retry stats. v_campaign_health_summary_delta: compare counts to summary JSONB.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_campaign_health AS SELECT c.id AS campaign_id, c.identifier AS campaign_identifier, c.name AS campaign_name, c.status AS campaign_status, c.created_at AS campaign_date, c.provider AS campaign_provider, c.provider_id AS campaign_provider_id, c.summary AS campaign_summary, c.provider_details AS provider_details, cfg.id AS config_id, cfg.identifier AS config_identifier, cfg.name AS config_name, cfg.status AS config_status, COALESCE(a.total_calls, 0) AS total_calls, COALESCE(a.completed_calls, 0) AS completed_calls, COALESCE(a.no_answer_calls, 0) AS no_answer_calls, COALESCE(a.busy_calls, 0) AS busy_calls, COALESCE(a.failed_calls, 0) AS failed_calls, COALESCE(a.other_status_calls, 0) AS other_status_calls, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.total_calls, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((100.0 * COALESCE(a.completed_calls, 0)) / a.total_calls, 2) END AS completed_pct, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.total_calls, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((100.0 * COALESCE(a.no_answer_calls, 0)) / a.total_calls, 2) END AS no_answer_pct, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.total_calls, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((100.0 * COALESCE(a.busy_calls, 0)) / a.total_calls, 2) END AS busy_pct, CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.total_calls, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((100.0 * COALESCE(a.failed_calls, 0)) / a.total_calls, 2) END AS failed_pct, ROUND(a.avg_duration_seconds::numeric, 2) AS avg_duration_seconds, COALESCE(r.unique_numbers, 0) AS unique_numbers, COALESCE(r.retried_numbers, 0) AS retried_numbers, COALESCE(r.retry_succeeded, 0) AS retry_succeeded, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.retried_numbers, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((100.0 * r.retry_succeeded) / r.retried_numbers, 2) END AS retry_success_pct FROM n_campaign c LEFT JOIN n_campaign_config cfg ON cfg.id = c.config_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cl.campaign_id, COUNT(*) AS total_calls, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cl.status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_calls, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cl.status = 'NO_ANSWER') AS no_answer_calls, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cl.status = 'BUSY') AS busy_calls, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cl.status = 'FAILED') AS failed_calls, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE cl.status IS NULL OR cl.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'NO_ANSWER', 'BUSY', 'FAILED') ) AS other_status_calls, AVG( CASE WHEN cl.status = 'COMPLETED' AND cl.completion_details IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(cl.completion_details->'duration') IN ('number', 'string') THEN CASE jsonb_typeof(cl.completion_details->'duration') WHEN 'number' THEN (cl.completion_details->'duration')::text::double precision ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(cl.completion_details->>'duration'), '')::double precision END ELSE NULL END ) AS avg_duration_seconds FROM n_call_log cl WHERE cl.campaign_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cl.campaign_id ) a ON a.campaign_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT campaign_id, COUNT(DISTINCT to_number) AS unique_numbers, COUNT(DISTINCT to_number) FILTER (WHERE call_count > 1) AS retried_numbers, COUNT(DISTINCT to_number) FILTER (WHERE call_count > 1 AND completed_count > 0) AS retry_succeeded FROM ( SELECT campaign_id, to_number, COUNT(*) AS call_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_count FROM n_call_log WHERE campaign_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY campaign_id, to_number ) per_number GROUP BY campaign_id ) r ON r.campaign_id = c.id;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_campaign_health_summary_delta AS SELECT h.campaign_id, h.campaign_identifier, h.campaign_name, h.campaign_status, h.campaign_date, h.total_calls, h.completed_calls, h.failed_calls, (h.campaign_summary->>'scheduled')::bigint AS summary_scheduled, (h.campaign_summary->>'initialized')::bigint AS summary_initialized, (h.campaign_summary->>'completed')::bigint AS summary_completed, (h.campaign_summary->>'failed')::bigint AS summary_failed, (h.campaign_summary->>'inProgress')::bigint AS summary_in_progress, (h.completed_calls IS DISTINCT FROM (h.campaign_summary->>'completed')::bigint) AS discrepancy_completed, (h.failed_calls IS DISTINCT FROM (h.campaign_summary->>'failed')::bigint) AS discrepancy_failed, (h.total_calls IS DISTINCT FROM (h.campaign_summary->>'scheduled')::bigint) AS discrepancy_total_vs_summary_scheduled FROM v_campaign_health h;
